title: Solstice world preset contract
description: Realm generation parameters. Truth: docs/setting/WORLD.md SS2.1 (scale), SS2.2 (biome thresholds), SS3.3 (creation flow). Read at runtime from game/Config/Solstice/Data/world.json. One tile is one metre.

realm_id.description: Stable identity of the realm, e.g. realm.valley.

size.description: Tiles per axis. The M0 small realm is 128 (docs/setting/WORLD.md SS2.1).

chunk_size.description: Tiles per chunk side; drives the dirty-region rebuild granularity.

algo.description: Terrain algorithm. Six ship in M0 so the creator's reshape step has something to choose from.

latitude.description: Drives the solar path and the season when the reality anchor is offline.

chaos_start.description: The realm begins as uncoloured paper with no life (docs/setting/WORLD.md SS3.3 step 5).

life_seed.description: Creator step 8. True seeds the species that the biomes can support.
